subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir hears a shout and recognizes the voice as Eldeth's.
source_quote: Zalthir recognizes the voice; it’s Eldeth.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin shouts that everyone is fine.
source_quote: Thorin shouts, “Yes, we’re all fine.”

subject: Zalthir dispels darkness
fact: Zalthir sighs and dispels the darkness.
source_quote: Zalthir sighs and dispels the darkness.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz shouts that he has the egg.
source_quote: Daz shouts, “I have the egg.”

subject: Pelek
fact: An unfamiliar Derro voice identifies itself as Pelek.
source_quote: And then an unfamiliar voice of a Derro shouts, “My goodness, this body is uncomfortable.”

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek says he has occupied this body.
source_quote: “Oh, yes, I am Pelek. I seem to have occupied this body.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks Pelek is the ghost.
source_quote: “The ghost,” he thinks.

subject: upper levels of the mesa
fact: The upper levels of the mesa are covered in blood and the broken bodies of the derro.
source_quote: The upper levels of the mesa are covered in blood and the broken bodies of the derro.

subject: spectator creature
fact: Near the tunnel entrance is a spectator, a creature similar to but different from a beholder.
source_quote: Where Eldeth is, near the tunnel entrance is a spectator, a creature similar to but different from a beholder.

subject: egg is missing
fact: There is no egg where it should be.
source_quote: He looks to where the egg should be. There is no egg.

subject: dead derro
fact: There are two dead derro near where the egg should be.
source_quote: There are two dead derro.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum shouts asking where the egg is.
source_quote: Grygum shouts, “Where is the egg?”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz repeats that he has the egg.
source_quote: Then Daz shouts back, “I have it.”

subject: Zalthir picks up Demogorgon statue
fact: Zalthir jumps off the mesa and picks up the statue of Demogorgon.
source_quote: Zalthir jumps off the mesa and heads to an alcove in the northeast corner. There, he picks up the statue of Demogorgon.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks to himself about Demogorgon as 'Leemooggoogoon, Demogorgon, two-headed baby dragons'.
source_quote: “Leemooggoogoon, Demogorgon, two-headed baby dragons - …” he thinks to himself.

subject: northwest corner desk
fact: Zalthir goes to the northwest corner where there is a desk with some papers.
source_quote: he heads to the northwest corner where there is a desk with some papers.

subject: Pliinki's journal
fact: Zalthir finds a journal by Pliinki.
source_quote: He finds a journal by Pliinki.

subject: letters from Pliinki and others
fact: Zalthir finds some letters addressed to and from Pliinki.
source_quote: He also finds some letters

subject: Pliinki's journal entry: Stone of Diirinka
fact: Pliinki's journal records that the Obelisk's black metal hums with quasi-magical energy.
source_quote: The Obelisk. Such a magnificent, fractured thing! Hidden here by Diirinka himself, I am certain. Its black metal hums with quasi-magical energy, a power just waiting to be unleashed.

subject: Pliinki's journal entry: Stone of Diirinka
fact: Pliinki tried to mend the Obelisk's cracks with Thrazgad ore, but it was discarded and forgotten.
source_quote: I have tried the Thrazgad ore, as Narrak suggested, to mend its cracks, but it merely sits "discarded and forgotten" next to my workbenches.

subject: Pliinki's journal entry: The Prince's Gift Arrives
fact: Pliinki received the Red Dragon Egg from the Gray Ghosts.
source_quote: The Gray Ghosts delivered it! The Red Dragon Egg!

subject: Pliinki's journal entry: The Prince's Gift Arrives
fact: Pliinki believes the egg is the vessel for her greatest creation, a gift worthy of Demogorgon.
source_quote: This is no mere insurance policy; it is the vessel for my greatest creation, a gift worthy of Demogorgon himself.

subject: Pliinki's journal entry: Mutagenic Progress!
fact: Pliinki's experiments show the egg is pulsing with new life and mutations are taking hold.
source_quote: The egg pulses with new life, and my notes confirm my suspicions: the mutations are taking hold.

subject: Pliinki's journal entry: Mutagenic Progress!
fact: Pliinki's goal is to create a two-headed wyrmling as a gift for Demogorgon to serve as his mount.
source_quote: My goal is clear, a two-headed wyrmling, a perfect "Prince's gift" for Demogorgon, to serve as his mount.

subject: Pliinki's journal entry: The Obelisk Responds
fact: Pliinki pressed her hand to the Obelisk and the air around it flared.
source_quote: I pressed my hand to the Obelisk again, channeling the energy of the Whorlstone Tunnels into its fractures. It didn't just flash this time; the very air around it flared!

subject: Pliinki's journal entry: Anticipation and Destiny
fact: Pliinki believes the Obelisk and the egg will herald Demogorgon's arrival and trigger a genocidal war.
source_quote: The Obelisk, too, senses the coming shift. Its purpose, alongside the egg, is to herald the Prince's arrival and the "genocidal war" that will cleanse this city.

subject: Letter 1: Pliinki to Uskvil
fact: Pliinki writes that the Gray Ghosts delivered the egg as planned.
source_quote: The Egg has arrived! Your operatives, those foolish Gray Ghosts, delivered it precisely as planned,

subject: Letter 1: Pliinki to Uskvil
fact: Pliinki states that the Thrazgad ore has been discarded and forgotten beside her workbenches.
source_quote: It still sits "discarded and forgotten" next to my workbenches.

subject: Letter 1: Pliinki to Uskvil
fact: Pliinki writes that the Obelisk must be repaired to conquer Gracklstugh and offer it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.
source_quote: We must find a way to mend its fractures, for it is the key to conquering Gracklstugh and offering it as a sacrificial gift to our Lord.

subject: Letter 2: Aliinka to Pliinki
fact: Aliinka confirms that the Gray Ghosts successfully retrieved the dragon egg and Thrazgad ore.
source_quote: Uskvil confirmed the successful retrieval of both the dragon egg and the Clan Thrazgad ore, as ordered.

subject: Letter 2: Aliinka to Pliinki
fact: Aliinka states that the Council's indoctrination has succeeded through 'Y' carvings.
source_quote: Almost all members have now embraced the true path, thanks to our careful placements of the 'Y' carvings.

subject: Letter 3: Pliinki to Uskvil
fact: Pliinki expresses frustration that the Thrazgad ore failed to mend the Obelisk.
source_quote: That acid-resistant ore from the Thrazgad Clan, which you so expertly acquired, has proven useless in mending its cracks.

subject: Letter 3: Pliinki to Uskvil
fact: Pliinki says the two-headed mutation in the egg is nearly complete.
source_quote: The two-headed mutation is nearly complete, a testament to the Prince's foresight and my dedication.

subject: Letter 4: Narrak to Pliinki
fact: Narrak confirms that the Obelisk, once repaired, will be the instrument of ascension to deliver Gracklstugh to Demogorgon.
source_quote: This ancient monolith, once repaired, will be the instrument of our ascension, allowing us to conquer Gracklstugh and deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.

subject: Letter 4: Narrak to Pliinki
fact: Narrak writes that the genocidal war against the derro is intended as the first cleansing.
source_quote: the "genocidal war" against the derro that Gartokkar so desires will merely be the first cleansing.

subject: Zalthir concludes the Derro and Duergar must be condemned
fact: Zalthir knows he has enough to condemn the Derro and Duergar to a genocidal war that will destroy Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Zalthir knows he has enough to condemn the Derro and Duergar to a genocidal war that will result in the utter destruction of the city of Gracklstugh.

subject: Grygum reads Pliinki's journal
fact: Grygum reads what Zalthir has found and is disturbed.
source_quote: Grygum reads what Zalthir has found and is disturbed.

subject: Grygum remembers Bahamut's teaching
fact: Grygum remembers a temple teaching about the egg: 'When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride, does one mend the shell, or seek to free the spark within?'
source_quote: "When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride, does one mend the shell, or seek to free the spark within? The true wyrm's form is not etched by fate's first breath, nor by sorcerous hand. It is the choices that twist the spirit, or set it soaring. To break the chains of another's dark design, even when madness fuels the crafting, is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes.”

subject: Grygum declares egg should be returned to Gartokkar
fact: Grygum declares, “We shall return the egg to Gartokkar.”
source_quote: “We shall return the egg to Gartokkar,” he declares.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir stares at Grygum, confused by his declaration.
source_quote: Zalthir stares at him, confused, “What?”

subject: Grygum explains the egg is now a demon manifestation
fact: Grygum says the egg is no longer a dragon and will bring revenge through Themberchaud.
source_quote: “This is no longer a dragon. And so when this abomination hatches, the dragon Themberchaud will have its revenge on those who would think to control it.”

subject: giant baby rattle
fact: Thorin finds a giant baby rattle that looks like it would fit a dragon.
source_quote: There is Thorin with a baby rattle. A giant baby rattle that looks like it would fit a dragon.

subject: giant baby rattle
fact: The baby rattle says 'made by clan Thrazgad'.
source_quote: It says made by clan Thrazgad.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says he would like to have a dragon.
source_quote: We should get a baby dragon. I would like to have a dragon. It would be so cool if we had a dragon.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is appalled by Thorin's comment about wanting a pure dragon.
source_quote: Grygum is appalled.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin apologizes for implying Grygum wanted a pure dragon.
source_quote: I’m sorry. I didn’t mean that we don’t have a pure dragon, and that I wanted a pure dragon.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum coughs and watches Zalthir clench and unclench his fists.
source_quote: Grygum coughs. He watches as Thorin stares at him and realizes what he said... Grygum watches Zalthir clench and unclench.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says he is still partial to riding Themberchaud out of the place.
source_quote: “So what do we do? I am still partial to the ride Thermbechaude out of this place.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir votes to leave Gracklstugh as discreetly as possible with minimal chaos.
source_quote: Zalthir mutters, “I vote we get out of here as discreetly as possible, creating the least amount of chaos as possible.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin sighs and agrees with Zalthir's plan.
source_quote: Thorin sighs, “Yeah.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum pulls out a scrap of paper with notes on their deals.
source_quote: Grygum pulls out a scrap of paper, “I’ve been taking notes on all of the deals we have made.”

subject: Grygum proposes giving egg to Gartokkar to escape
fact: Grygum proposes giving the egg to Gartokkar and using him to escape, claiming the Derro didn't steal it.
source_quote: I take notes. It’s what I do. ... We tell Gartokkar that the Derro didn’t steal the egg, but some other crazed group. We also explain that we need his help to escape because of the deal we made with the Stone guards and that if Errde were to imprison us, we might be compelled to change our story under torture.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin nods in agreement to Grygum's plan.
source_quote: Thorin nods, “Let’s do it.”

subject: Thorin demands a name for their group
fact: Thorin stops the group and demands they choose a name for their group.
source_quote: But Thorin stops them. “We need a name.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum suggests “The Second Faction” as a name.
source_quote: Grygum mutters, “The Second Faction?”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz says “The Second Faction” is too derivative.
source_quote: Daz says what he is thinking, “Too derivative.”

subject: group adopts name 'The Ember Vanguard'
fact: Daz proposes the name 'The Ember Vanguard' and the group accepts it.
source_quote: And then he smiles, “I have it - The Ember Vanguard.”

subject: group agrees to leave via different tunnel
fact: The group chooses not to return the way they came, fearing the Empty-Scabbard Killers.
source_quote: As Zalthir explains, “The Empty Scabbard Killers might want to kill us.”

subject: double doors in cave tunnel
fact: The group reaches a pair of double doors at the end of a cave tunnel.
source_quote: they go down a different cave tunnel, which leads to a pair of double doors.

subject: Diirdeklin
fact: Diirdeklin has been guarding the post for days, believing Pliinki’s promise of Derro liberation.
source_quote: Diirdeklin has been at this guard post for days. Pliinki has promised him that this is part of some plan that will free the Derro from the bondage of Duergar.

subject: Diirdeklin
fact: Diirdeklin hears noise from the north and becomes worried.
source_quote: There is a noise coming from the north. That’s odd. It doesn’t sound like Derro. He’s worried.

subject: Diirdeklin hears 'The people you are trying to warn are dead'
fact: A booming voice tells Diirdeklin, “The people you are trying to warn are dead.”
source_quote: And then he hears a booming voice - “The people you are trying to warn are dead.”

subject: Diirdeklin
fact: Diirdeklin drops the alarm bell and grips his weapon tighter.
source_quote: Diirdeklin’s hand drops the alarm bell and grabs his weapon more tightly.

subject: Drow Archmage
fact: A Drow Archmage has summoned a meteor swarm.
source_quote: he sees a Drow Archmage who has summoned a meteor swarm.

subject: Drow identify as The Ember Vanguard
fact: The Drow shouts, “We are The Ember Vanguard, and you will let us pass!”
source_quote: The Drow shouts, “We are The Ember Vanguard, and you will let us pass!”

subject: Diirdeklin
fact: Diirdeklin yields and lets the group pass, fearing for his life.
source_quote: Diirdeklin worried that Diinarnnmyr might foolishly try to fight, shouts, “Yes, pass!”

subject: Diirdeklin
fact: Diirdeklin thinks the Drow incursion is bad and that they may have killed Pliinki.
source_quote: As they leave the cave, he thinks, “A Drow incursion! This is not good. And if they killed Pliinki, that means that they have bigger plans.”

subject: Diinarnnmyr
fact: Diinarnnmyr mutters that the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue the Derro.
source_quote: As they leave Diinarnnmyr mutters, “The Ember Vanguard - the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue us!”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is pleased with his use of dancing lights on the Derro.
source_quote: Daz is very pleased with his use of dancing lights and the effect it had on the Derro.

subject: group is congratulated for being The Ember Vanguard
fact: Thorin shouts, “The Ember Vanguard are in the house!”
source_quote: Thorin shouts, “The Ember Vanguard are in the house!”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz likes the idea of being a feared group of mercenaries called The Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: The mage likes the idea of being a feared group of mercenaries instead of a pathetic group of adventurers who are running around trying to stay alive.
